goal: A concise, honest 10-slide TOKEN2049 ORIGINS pitch for Cardano judges: customer pain, Wallet QA value, real swap evidence, Cardano payment role, implementation limits, and pilot ask.

deck_context.source_summary: Wallet QA turns a small Web3 team's request into approved assertions, bounded real-wallet testing, and an evidence-backed report. Cardano preprod is for buying the QA service, while the tested app may run on another chain. Masumi escrow and direct x402 are separate routes. A real browser swap succeeded on chain but the Playwright assertion for an explorer tab failed; cause unresolved. Paid host-to-browser handoff remains manual. No complete paid QA loop or live x402 settlement is verified.
deck_context.core_claim: The button is not the proof: a useful QA result reconciles browser, wallet, and chain evidence against buyer-approved expectations.
deck_context.status_legend: Verified means directly observed/tested; partial means code exists but integration or live validation remains; planned means future work.
